about: W11 corpus: real differentially private releases, transcribed from their own primary documentation and run through the SynthProof boundary auditor. Every 'documented' or 'partial' status cites a source fetched on the date given, with a short quote or a close paraphrase marked as such. 'not_documented' means not found in the fetched sources, not proof of absence everywhere. 'not_applicable' means the release publishes nothing the property concerns (e.g. no fingerprint, no empirical privacy metric). The `sheet` block holds only documented values, in Privacy Data Sheet field names, for synthproof.audit.boundary.audit_sheet.

properties.P4: unit of privacy / neighbouring relation stated
properties.P5: basis of any exact size or total stated (or none released exactly)
properties.P7: input fingerprint keyed (only if a fingerprint is published)
properties.P8: measurements on the confidential data labelled or charged
properties.P9: operating range of any empirical privacy metric (only if one is published)
properties.P11: privacy claim machine-checkable from the artefact
